parameters.content:
## MLB Teams, Player Search & Season Schedule Lookup

**Actor:** [MLB Teams, Player Search & Season Schedule Lookup](https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs/mlb-teams-player-search-and-season-schedule-lookup)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/mlb-teams-player-search-and-season-schedule-lookup.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `searchQuery` (string)
- `season` (string)
- `maxItems` (integer)

### Output fields
- `teamName` (Team Name)
- `playerName` (Player Name)
- `eventName` (Event Name)
- `homeTeam` (Home Team)
- `awayTeam` (Away Team)
- `matchDate` (Match Date)

description: MLB teams, player search: runs the MLB Teams, Player Search & Season Schedule Lookup Apify Actor, returns teamName, playerName, eventName, homeTeam, awayTeam and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
